scope: All countries with leading house numbers
affected: address parser silently drops the house number
description: The street parser expects the street name first and the number after it, which is the continental pattern. For addresses written the British way, number first, the pattern fails and the parser falls back to matching on street name alone with an empty house number. Two such addresses then match on street name only. This is the exact false-positive class fixed in QA-048, reappearing through a different route. It surfaced on ION Harbour at 11 St. Barbara Bastion matching Iniala Valletta at number 10. That particular link happens to be correct and is kept, but it was reached by accident. Malta, Ireland, the United Kingdom and the United States all use this address form.
recommended_action: Fix the parser to handle a leading house number before running the linker over any British-form address market
